Also: a render takes an exclusive DuckDB lock on the cached stats database (~/.etude/statsdb/<experiment>.<digest>.duckdb), so a second render or any read-only query (etude.eval.query.statsdb) fails with statsdb_in_use (409) for the whole multi-minute render. Seen on tla_trophies_floor with the 40-minute re-render and a concurrent profiling render. Reading stored results must never block on a render: readers should open read-only or a published snapshot, and only the step that ingests new blocks should write, briefly.
